Guidance & outlook: So, basically, we are targeting that 80 to 90% of the cargo is generated out of the forwarding as well as the NVOCC division.
What we are targeting out of our total top line, we are targeting that vessel operation next year should give around 30% to 40% of our top line.
When we target turnaround of say, next year, I am targeting, suppose another 35% to 40% growth next year from this financial year.
Growth & demand: During the quarter on a consolidated basis, we recorded a revenue of 157.1 crores, reflecting a year-on-year growth of 26.5%.
